text:
My neighbor decided to take security seriously, slapping up a bold "Beware of Dog" sign. The irony began the moment the postman arrived. Out trotted my three-pound furball, a creature so small he could fit inside a coffee mug. The postman looked down, saw the tiny fluff ball, and deadpanned, "Oh no, I'm so scared!"

That comment broke my dog. He took it as a personal challenge. Now, he’s on a relentless mission to prove the postman wrong. He doesn’t bark; he just stares intensely, vibrating with the sheer effort of looking like a predator. He’s currently practicing his "menacing growl," which sounds suspiciously like a squeaky toy being stepped on. I’m pretty sure he’s going to try to intimidate the mail carrier by standing on his hind legs and reaching for the postman’s knee, which is only about two feet off the ground. It’s less "Beware of Dog" and more "Please Don't Laugh at Me."

As for the eggplant? It’s purple.
